Pending parent openedSettlement compares actual cut history facts with checkpoint identity, so it rejects this incomplete proof. No settlementAcl is required in the preserved early cryptographic verify pass. No runtime probe or fixture correction was performed.

Direct pure inspectCreatorAuthorSettlementAdvance receives two-key ACL stubs and one-key members. Signed93585bf3 exactSettlementAcl requires full six-key ACL and exact member/group shape; current patch does not change this pure law owner. This is independently inherited fixture incompatibility, not the parent stage ACL requirement.

disposition: Stopped at new cause family. Do not relax history binding or exact ACL custody, manufacture hash facts, relabel as passed, or edit tests without separate root authorization. Remaining gates57 onward unexecuted at this stop.
